import Pkg

function initstacks_raggedind_b(m0, n)
    prefix_s_stack_1 = Vector{Int}(undef, div(n - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_s_stack_1 = 0
    prefix_tripcount_stack_1 = Vector{Int}(undef, div(n - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = 0
    val_w_1 = Vector{Int64}(undef, div(n - 1, 1) + 1)
    for i_x = 1:n
        prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] = __tot_s_stack_1
        prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] = __tot_tripcount_stack_1
        w = m0 + i_x
        s = 0.0
        val_w_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] = w
        __tot_s_stack_1 = __tot_s_stack_1 + ((1 + (div(w - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1)
        __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = __tot_tripcount_stack_1 + 1
    end
    s_stack = Vector{Float64}(undef, __tot_s_stack_1 + 1)
    tripcount_stack = Vector{Int64}(undef, __tot_tripcount_stack_1)
    return (s_stack, tripcount_stack, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_s_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1, val_w_1)
end

function raggedind_b(out, outb, u, ub, x, xb, n, m0, s_stack, tripcount_stack, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_s_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1, val_w_1)
    s = 0.0
    sb = 0.0
    for i_x = 1:n
        w = m0 + i_x
        __idx_s_stack_1_1 = prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1
        s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_1] = s
        s = 0.0
        __idx_tripcount_stack_1_4 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1
        tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_4] = w
        for i_j = 1:w
            __idx_s_stack_1_0 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1) + ((i_j - 1) + 1)
            s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0] = s
            s = s + x[i_j] * u[i_x]
        end
        out[i_x] = s * s
        __idx_s_stack_1_8 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + (1 + (div(val_w_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] - 1, 1) + 1))) + 1
        s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_8] = s
    end
    s_stack[__tot_s_stack_1 + 1] = s
    s = s_stack[__tot_s_stack_1 + 1]
    for i_x = n:-1:1
        __idx_s_stack_1_0 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + (1 + (div(val_w_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] - 1, 1) + 1))) + 1
        s = s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0]
        w = m0 + i_x
        sb = sb + s * outb[i_x]
        sb = sb + s * outb[i_x]
        outb[i_x] = 0.0
        __idx_tripcount_stack_1_6 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1
        w = tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_6]
        for i_j = w:-1:1
            __idx_s_stack_1_0 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1) + ((i_j - 1) + 1)
            s = s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0]
            xb[i_j] = xb[i_j] + u[i_x] * sb
            ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + x[i_j] * sb
        end
        __idx_s_stack_1_0 = prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1
        s = s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0]
        sb = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_raggedind_b_cuda(m0, n)
    prefix_s_stack_1 = CuArray{Int}(undef, div(n - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_s_stack_1 = 0
    prefix_tripcount_stack_1 = CuArray{Int}(undef, div(n - 1, 1) + 1)
    __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = 0
    val_w_1 = CuArray{Int64}(undef, div(n - 1, 1) + 1)
    for i_x = 1:n
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] = __tot_s_stack_1
                prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] = __tot_tripcount_stack_1
                w = m0 + i_x

                __tot_s_stack_1 = __tot_s_stack_1 + ((1 + (div(w - 1, 1) + 1)) + 1)
                __tot_tripcount_stack_1 = __tot_tripcount_stack_1 + 1
            end
    end
    s_stack = CuArray{Float64}(undef, __tot_s_stack_1 + 1)
    tripcount_stack = CuArray{Int64}(undef, __tot_tripcount_stack_1)
    return (s_stack, tripcount_stack, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_s_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1, val_w_1)

function raggedind_b_cuda(out, outb, u, ub, x, xb, n, m0, s_stack, tripcount_stack, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, __tot_s_stack_1, __tot_tripcount_stack_1, val_w_1)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    s = 0.0
    sb = 0.0
    for i_x = 1:n
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                w = m0 + i_x
                __idx_s_stack_1_1 = prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1
                s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_1] = s
                s = 0.0
                __idx_tripcount_stack_1_4 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1
                tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_4] = w
            end
        for i_j = 1:w
            CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                    __idx_s_stack_1_0 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1) + ((i_j - 1) + 1)
                    s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0] = s
                    s = s + x[i_j] * u[i_x]
                end
        end
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                out[i_x] = s * s
                __idx_s_stack_1_8 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + (1 + (div(val_w_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] - 1, 1) + 1))) + 1
                s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_8] = s
            end
    end
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            s_stack[__tot_s_stack_1 + 1] = s
            s = s_stack[__tot_s_stack_1 + 1]
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_raggedind_b_1!(m0, n, outb, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, s_stack, tripcount_stack, u, ub, val_w_1, x, xb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_raggedind_b_1!(m0, n, outb, prefix_s_stack_1, prefix_tripcount_stack_1, s_stack, tripcount_stack, u, ub, val_w_1, x, xb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    sb = 0.0
    __idx_s_stack_1_0 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + (1 + (div(val_w_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] - 1, 1) + 1))) + 1
    s = s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0]
    w = m0 + i_x
    sb = sb + s * outb[i_x]
    sb = sb + s * outb[i_x]
    outb[i_x] = 0.0
    __idx_tripcount_stack_1_6 = prefix_tripcount_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1
    w = tripcount_stack[__idx_tripcount_stack_1_6]
    for i_j = w:-1:1
        __idx_s_stack_1_0 = (prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1) + ((i_j - 1) + 1)
        s = s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0]
        CUDA.@atomic xb[i_j] += u[i_x] * sb
        ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + x[i_j] * sb
    end
    __idx_s_stack_1_0 = prefix_s_stack_1[(i_x - 1) + 1] + 1
    s = s_stack[__idx_s_stack_1_0]
    sb = 0.0
    return nothing
end

    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end
